author: smitdalt
body:
Friends,

There isn't much for me to say here, mostly that I am sorry for being an jerk and using an alt to cheat. It was immature and selfish. I should've thought about other players' experience and of course I realize this too late. Hindsight is a great thing. Anyways, I think I am more mature overall as a person and on the internet. I don't intentionally try to irritate people and cause conflicts, and I certainly don't hack to ruin others' fun. I am pretty disappointed in myself, as I'm sure you all are as well, but I am ready to try again and be a better member of the community.

Thank you very much for considering my appeal <3
-smitdalt

title: Appeal

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Smitdalt,

I find it good of you that you owed up, and faced the consequences of your actions. You do seems sorry, and I feel that you have in fact matured of past 3 months. I am going to unban you. Please don't make me regret this. If you're banned again, you will have no chance of being appealed, so please, think before you act.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
